reason: These files claim a real ISO build and QEMU boot that never happened. No Stage 1 build has ever completed (workflow run 42350004853 failed with zero jobs), the claimed kernel 6.1.0-54-amd64 is not in the assessed pinned set, the serial log shows a BusyBox initramfs rescue shell rather than a booted userspace, and the recorded boot duration of 7 seconds is not a boot. Nothing in the repository writes these files; they were placed by hand in commit 66dbad8.

not_quarantined.real-kernel-validation.json: Genuine. Produced by workflow run 42435089947 (success), records that run id and head SHA 84d8ed07. Proves the kernel-architecture validator works; does not prove an OS boots.

remediation: Real evidence is produced only by dispatching .github/workflows/radar-os-stage1-build.yml after the owner records docs/os/DEBIAN-BASE-DECISION.json as approved.
